svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/145.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" version="29.6.0" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="KXUt8GGG5WvSWTgmfey2"> <mxGraphModel dx="1554" dy="770" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="0" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml

title TEMP? request overview

caption Host (uartctl.py) ↔ Gateway (STM32 + nRF24) ↔ Remote (STM32 + nRF24)

skinparam shadowing false
skinparam ArrowColor #444444
skinparam ArrowThickness 1.2

skinparam activity {
 BorderColor #444444
 FontColor #222222
 BackgroundColor #f8f8f8
}

|Host|
start
:Open serial port;
:UART TX \"TEMP?\n\";

|Gateway|
:UART RX line;
if (line == \"TEMP?\") then (yes)
else (no)
 :UART TX \"ERR\n\";
 |Host|
 :Report error;
 stop
endif

|Gateway|
:RF request \"GTMP\";
:TX phase (send request);
if (TX ok?) then (yes)
else (no)
 :UART TX \"TEMP FAIL (TX)\n\";
 |Host|
 :Report error;
 stop
endif

|Gateway|
:Enter RX wait for \"TMP!\";

fork
 |Gateway|
 :RX wait (<=200 ms);\naccept only \"TMP!\";
fork again
 |Remote|
 :Receive \"GTMP\";
 :Build \"TMP!\" reply;
 :Send reply;
end fork

|Gateway|
if (Got \"TMP!\"?) then (no)
 :UART TX \"TEMP FAIL (RX timeout)\n\";
 |Host|
 :Report error;
 stop
else (yes)
 |Gateway|
 :Unpack temps;
 :UART TX \"TEMP ...\n\";
endif

|Host|
:Read response line;
if (Starts with \"TEMP \"?) then (yes)
 :Parse key=value;
 if (--json?) then (yes)
 :Emit JSON;
 else (no)
 :Print human summary;
 endif
else (no)
 :Report failure or bad response;
endif
stop
